subject: Offline delivery certification and operator training plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@finsecure.com>, secops@ironbank.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Offline delivery certification and operator training plan
Attachments: signed-manifest-template.csv (csv), operator-training-outline.pdf (pdf)

Hi all,

Following our kickoff with IronBank last week, attaching a first-pass operator training outline and the manifest template IronBank requested for their audit package. Two asks to get aligned this week:

1) Certification window: IronBank requested a 2-hour activation window on their isolated cluster during the week of Oct 4. We need to confirm operator availability and signatory roster.
2) Evidence package: they want SHA256 checksums for bundles and the signing key metadata (key id and KMS/HSM provenance). See the manifest template.

Karthik, can you comment on whether the current signed-bundle flow needs changes to include HSM attestation statements? Jordan, can your team schedule the training session with ops and confirm the proctoring plan?

I copied Alyssa from IronBank for initial QA — Alyssa, if there are additional compliance artifacts you need (e.g., ephemeral key ceremony logs), tell us and we'll include them in the evidence workbook.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@finsecure.com>, secops@ironbank.com
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offline delivery certification and operator training plan
Attachments: airgap-evidence-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Vanessa — thanks for the notes. Quick technical points from the runtime/group: 

- Signing metadata: current flow emits signature metadata (key id, algorithm, signature) but not the HSM attestation blob. We can add an attestation field to the manifest (TPM/HSM quote) but will need the IronBank attestation verification fingerprint to embed in our verification step.
- Key rotation: if the activation happens after our next scheduled rotation (09-28), the bundle must be re-signed. Recommend locking the signer for 7 days pre-activation to avoid churn.
- Offline verification tool: I'll attach an evidence checklist with the verification commands and expected outputs (sha256 checksums, manifest signature, kms:sign key id).

Proposed schedule:
- Training dry-run (internal): Sep 28, 10:00-11:30 PT
- Customer-facing training + activation rehearsal: Oct 1, 09:00-11:00 PT
- Activation window (customer): Oct 6, 14:00-16:00 ET (to accommodate their East Coast ops)

Jordan — please confirm operator list and whether we can get the locked signer window from release. If anything blocks the signer lock we should consider a short hotfix plan.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: secops@ironbank.com <secops@ironbank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@finsecure.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:48:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Offline delivery certification and operator training plan

Vanessa / Karthik — thanks for the outline. A couple clarifications from IronBank SecOps before we lock the activation window: 

1) Attestation artifacts: We require the HSM attestation and the signer public key certificate chain in the evidence package. A base64-encoded attestation blob is fine.
2) Audit trail: We need operator proctoring notes and a single line log proving the manifest verification command run on the host (timestamped).
3) Rollback acceptance criteria: Ideally, provide a documented rollback trigger (e.g., failed smoke tests X, Y) and a rollback package (previous image sha256) in the deliverable.

We can accommodate Oct 6 but would prefer Oct 5 for the activation window if you can move it earlier — our on-site team has limited access on the 6th.

Also, please add the DocuSign envelope for the operator roster and the temporary escalation contacts (we require named signers).

- IronBank SecOps (on behalf of Alyssa Chen)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: secops@ironbank.com, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@finsecure.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Offline delivery certification and operator training plan

Alyssa / IronBank — thanks for the quick turnaround and the additional asks. Action summary below, with links and owners. I've attached the completed evidence checklist and updated the manifest template to include an "hsm_attestation" field.

Action items:
- Provide HSM attestation and public cert chain: Karthik to embed hsm_attestation:sha256(...) in manifest; due Sep 28.
- Lock signer: Release team to lock signing key from Sep 28 - Oct 7. (Jordan to confirm operator blackout window.)
- Operator roster + DocuSign: I created a DocuSign envelope for the named signers; link: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-IRONBANK. Please have the listed operators sign by Sep 30.
- Rollback package: I exported the previous approved image sha256 (sha256:4f8c2d...) and uploaded to the evidence drive.
- Training: Jordan to schedule internal dry-run Sep 28 and customer rehearsal Oct 1.

Forwarded message (original manifest snippet):
> {
>   "bundle_name": "redwood-airgap-2026-09-24",
>   "bundle_sha256": "sha256:9b7a1c5e...",
>   "signer_key_id": "rk-2026-09-01-01",
>   "hsm_attestation": "<placeholder for attestation blob>"
> }

Alyssa — if you confirm Oct 5 is acceptable we'll move the activation window to Oct 5, 13:00-15:00 ET and send the updated DocuSign reminder. If IronBank needs the attestation in a specific format (e.g., TPM quote vs Cloud HSM CSR), let Karthik know; we'll convert.

Thanks everyone — circling for sign-offs.

Marissa Cole
Program Manager, Customer Deployments
